column1: # bug-node-index.tsv - LAYER D: every Figma node-id referenced by an OPEN bug report,
# resolved to {type, name, depth, owning screen, page, catalog section}.
# Built 2026-08-13 from: open bug_reports (status in new/needs_info/backlog/reopened/in_progress)
# with a non-empty figma_link -> 488 reports / 445 distinct links / 430 distinct (fileKey,node) pairs.
# Resolution method: figma.getNodeByIdAsync(id), then walk .parent to the PAGE and record the
# last node before it as the owning screen. This is the layer-D method CATALOG_DESIGN.md specifies.
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: the catalog indexes top-level children of a page (whole screens), but
# reporters link to the thing that is wrong - a panel, modal or button nested 1-12 levels deep.
# Before this file, 332 of 430 bug-linked nodes (77%) resolved to nothing in the catalog.
# status column:
#   screen   = the link points at a catalogued top-level screen (depth 0)
#   child    = a descendant of a catalogued screen, resolved in the file the link named
#   retarget = resolved in a DIFFERENT file than the link named - the link file key is STALE.
#              Use resolvedFileKey, not linkFileKey. See FILE_ROUTING.md.
#   alias    = already covered by a bugref-aliases.tsv row
#   gone     = resolves in NEITHER product file NOR the Games file. Deleted upstream in Figma.
#              Verified twice, via getNodeByIdAsync and via get_metadata. Do not treat these as
#              a coverage gap and do not go looking for them - the design node no longer exists.
# 2026-08-13 CORRECTION (wave-4 trench lane): four rows below were marked `alias` onto
#   parents 9899-106438 / 9896-104373 / 9893-94731. Those PARENTS do not resolve either.
#   Probed with figma.getNodeByIdAsync on BOTH product files, with 13006-212012 /
#   13006-210578 as a positive control (both found, page '✅ Trade 2'). All seven ids
#   9902-115168 are now `gone`. An `alias` row whose target is itself dead sends the
#   next reader looking for a frame that does not exist.
# depth = levels between the referenced node and its owning screen (0 = the screen itself).
# openRefs = number of OPEN bug reports pointing at this (linkFileKey,node) pair.

column1: # APPENDED 2026-08-19 - 7 new /rewards reports (552faf00, 2d17587a, b216f949, 757d795c,
# edcbc1d6, 3236d523, 9c5e45f9) post-date the 2026-08-13 build above, so none of their
# nodes were in it. Resolved by hand via get_metadata rather than the .parent walk:
#   8911-163463/163817/163781 tile the 1440x900 Rewards screen exactly (main x=58 y=92,
#     sidebar x=0 w=58, header y=0 h=92), which is how the owning screen was established.
#   8911-163781 is an INSTANCE of the shared Header-desktop-two-layer component - app-wide
#     chrome, NOT a rewards-specific frame. Treat b216f949 as a header-component question.
#   8911-161038 is the account menu ('dropdown-3'); its parent was NOT walked, so the
#     owningScreen columns are deliberately blank rather than guessed.
#   8909-139269 / 8909-141201 are both full 1440x900 overlay frames (the Sponsor market
#     rewards modal, steps 1 and 2) and are recorded as screens in their own right.
# 2026-08-26 REFRESH - layer D re-run against the CURRENT open backlog.
#   Source: bug_reports status in (new,needs_info,triaged,in_progress,backlog) with a figma_link,
#   plus free-text figma.com URLs. 279 reports -> 256 distinct (fileKey,node) pairs.
#   Of those 256: 10 were already registry frames, 65 already bugref-aliases rows, 39 already
#   indexed here, and the remaining 142 were unaccounted for. All 142 are appended below.
#   ALL 142 RESOLVED - zero `gone`. The gap was staleness, not deletion: this index was last
#   built 2026-08-13 and the backlog has turned over since.
# CAUTION for whoever re-runs this: 34 of the owning screens named below have NO registry.json
#   row. My first reading of that was WRONG and is recorded here so nobody repeats it: I called it
#   a layer-B coverage gap. It is not. 33 of the 34 are already present in predict/play/social
#   .nodes.txt - the SOURCE lists are complete. Only the DERIVED registry.json is behind, because
#   it was generated 2026-08-20 while the node lists have grown since (pages.json was re-harvested
#   2026-08-26). The fix is `node build-registry.mjs`, not adding ids.
#   ONE id is genuinely absent from any source list: 10130-14013 on the Games Towers page.
#   ! The general lesson: registry.json is a DERIVED artifact. Diffing against it and concluding
#   "the catalog is missing X" measures the rebuild date, not coverage. Check <section>.nodes.txt
#   before calling anything a gap.
# ! Frame TITLES in the Games file routinely name a DIFFERENT game than the page that owns them
#   (owningScreenTitle "...Blackjack..." on page "Limbo", "...Scratchers..." on page "Roulette").
#   The PAGE column is the reliable one. See TRAPS.md.
